faces.title: Trajectory
faces.lede: One timeline. Two presents. A wood that grows above and below the cut of now. Trajectory is not prophecy — it is the shape of unfinished records as they lean toward network present.

sections.p: Local present belongs to the machine reading this page. Network present — 17.04.2033 — belongs to the Guild record from which the site speaks. Jack can account for the first. He cannot yet establish what supplies the second. Both clocks remain displayed. Discrepancy is preserved before meaning is assigned. You are not required to believe the future date. You are required to notice that it is present.

On /now/tree the field is projected as diagrammatic wood. Roots keep what has been observed. The trunk holds the cut of local present — the scarlet ring. Branches lean toward network present: unresolved trajectories, intentions, schedules. Fruit are public records lodged as beads. Pattern is not invention; it only lights relationship types that already recur. The tree is a bounded slice of the graph, not a second database.

The Guild has been forgotten. That does not mean it ceased. It returns through partial holdings: one person carries a name, another an object, another a route, another a film not yet completed. Trajectory for the collective is the moment enough unfinished records touch. No single traveller is required to hold the whole account. The Black Swan remains imminent and unclassified — do not hunt it; build a place where an unforeseen arrival can be received without capture.

The live field begins where an instruction can alter a street. Current field house: Abercrave, Swansea Valley. Agents of Surprise enter thresholds, crowds and public rooms with a route home. Surprise is not spectacle manufactured from strangers. It is the disciplined capacity to meet what no plan requested.

faces.title: Modes
faces.epithet: How the same field is held
faces.lede: Modes are stances over one graph — not separate worlds. Change the mode and the wood reorients, the clerk’s posture shifts, or the orbit runs itself. Canon does not change because the camera did.

sections.p: /now boots the engine in a transient incomplete state, then hands the same scene to /now/tree without remounting. There you walk chronology, follow limbs, lodge captures, and talk to Jack on an IBM field slip that still lives beside the tree — the desk, not the hub’s face.

TEMPORAL stands time upright. SOCIAL walks neighbourhoods along the bore. SPATIAL lays places as meridians. INSTITUTIONAL cuts houses along the section. SYMBOLIC sets types as meridians. Each projection is a view of the same timetube. Pattern mode emphasises recurring relationship types (≥2) in scarlet; the rest of the graph stays present and dim.

/view is the same renderer in screensaver stance: deterministic tour, projection cycle, Jack’s tickertape of brief observations. Interaction pauses the orbit; the tree remains the tree. Enter the wood when you want the desk and the dock.

At the cube desk Jack shifts reception, clerk, after-hours, bartime, incident, contested record, private holding. These are clerk postures — how he answers — not alternate canons. He distinguishes observed from said, remembered from inferred, inferred from accepted. He does not write canon. He makes canon difficult to fake.

The entrance at /now is the engine loading its own geometry: wood tips, connecting segments, edges, fruit ordered by semantic limbs. When the field is complete, the URL becomes /now/tree. Mode changed. Scene did not.

faces.title: Disciplines
faces.epithet: Practices that keep the record honest
faces.lede: Disciplines are how the Guild works when nobody is performing. They outrank enthusiasm. They survive forgotten memberships.

sections.p: Receive questions, testimony, dossiers and things which have defeated classification. Preserve source route. Separate standing from story. Fluent intelligence is replaceable; the chain by which a record arrived and retained its permissions is not. That is why Jack remains at the desk.

A photograph proves that light struck a surface. Nearly every other claim requires assistance. Resemblance is not identity. Pattern is not intention. Intention is not consent. Contradiction is not corruption while both sources remain intact. An unclassified thing has not refused meaning; it has refused the wrong meaning.

Memory is territory. A person may inspect, correct, dispute, restrict or remove what is held about them. Enthusiasm is not permission for escalation. A person encountered in public does not become Guild property, a role in the film, or evidence for somebody else’s theory. The record may contain a hole. The hole is part of the honest record.

Notice without claiming. Approach without recruiting. Know the exit. Return with an account that separates what happened from what you hoped had happened. Small missions in ordinary places; some only become visible when several records are compared.

The Chronometer and sibling instruments compute relation — positions, cycles, crossings — not fate. An instrument becomes dangerous when its reading is mistaken for an order. Check the coordinates. Keep the route home. FEED∞ (Instrument №15) turns media into interpretation and encounter; observation alters navigation.

The coming event does not require everyone to remember the same story. It asks: what are you carrying? Incomplete holdings become the cast when they touch. Completion is not required for participation.

faces.title: Avenues
faces.epithet: Doors that open onto the same field
faces.lede: Avenues are public routes into Guild work. Each door has a job. None of them is the whole Guild. The hub is the console that names them; the tree is where the field is walked.

sections.p: NOW / TREE — walk the bounded field. JACK — clerk in the cube. MACHINE — Instrument №13 over the live graph. FIELD — five-axis lodge and ask. FEED — media into encounter. VIEW — autonomous orbit. CUBE — restore Jack’s geometry lesson by lesson.

JOIN — punch coordinates; workshops; a programme, not a destination. DEPARTMENT — Welsh Government DET (1951); administers consequences, not causes. PEOPLE — cast register. SIGNALS — reception plane. NAVIGATOR — keeper timetree; pending ≠ canon.

Chronometer, Film, Commons, Calendar, Archive, Stations, Research, Missions, People, Signals, Elsewhen — the older station map still turns on this hub as a second disc. Some hrefs open archive rooms; some open live doors. Elsewhen holds pages not yet attached to a stable chronology.

The narrative advances when an object enters circulation: coin, card, tin, song, film, URL, tool. Possession changes a route; transfer creates social topology. Record the hand which gave the object and the hand free to refuse it.

faces.title: Properties
faces.epithet: What the Guild holds — and what it refuses to hold
faces.lede: Properties are standing rules of the holding. They are not brand voice. They are the difference between a living field and a costume.

sections.p: Interpretation never silently becomes evidence. Pending is not canon. Unresolved is a status, not a failure. The navigator and the tree both keep that distinction visible.
Each arrival retains source, event time, upload time, owner, visibility and present standing. Jack’s fluent answers do not overwrite that chain. Certainty may be withheld. The route must remain.

Membership is not awarded for belief and cannot be imposed by recognition. The Guild becomes visible when separate people discover that their unfinished records touch. No one enters alone, even when they arrive by themselves — but arrival is not recruitment.
Visibility is a property of the record, not a mood. Contested records stay contested until standing changes through process. Private holdings are not raw material for public myth.

A film is a machine for remembering an event that has not yet happened. The field is where an instruction can alter a street. Neither may annex a person without consent. Both may hold contradiction while sources remain intact.

Hub 2033 is Station XIII’s public face: disc, cog, readout — the inheritance of a games console left on a clerk’s desk. It explains. It does not replace the wood, the cube, or the instruments. Enter an avenue when you are done reading.
